title: CosmicX
description: Unlimited Free Worldedit no voting required ✦ Unlimited 512x512 plots ✦ Axiom mod supported ✦ Access to goBrush, goPaint and Arceon build tools ✦ Redstone
body:
🌟 Welcome to CosmicX🌟

CosmicX is the perfect server for builders who want complete freedom and no limits getting in the way of their ideas. With massive plots, extremely high WorldEdit limits, and powerful building tools available from the start, it’s designed for people who want to create at a serious scale. Whether you’re building huge cities, detailed structures, or experimenting with new designs, CosmicX gives you the space and tools to make it happen.

🏗️ CREATIVE PLOTS 🏗️
- You can claim unlimited 512x512 plots
- Unlimited Worldedit with no voting required, maximum block limit is 100 million
- Axiom mod supported
- Access to goBrush, goPaint and Arceon build tools
- Unrestricted Redstone
- Armour Stand customisation Tools
- Player defined warps
- 50,000+ decorative heads


👷‍♂️ CREATIVE FREEBUILD 👷‍♂️
- Huge vanilla world to explore and build in
- Limitless creativity
- Open world to build in with no limits except griefing

🔨 PRIVATE REALMS 🔨
- Enjoy your own private world with friends or solo
- Start your own SMP or creative world, invite who you wish
- Customisable worlds

🏝️ SKYBLOCK 🏝️
- Choose either a CosmicX island or a classic island
- Invite people to collaborate and build your island

🏛️ CAPITAL CITY 🏛️
- Own customizable properties
- Add your own spice to the community
- Explore our realistic capital city that boasts property purchasing, selling, and a fully functional underground/metro/subway system!
